topics.topic: Representation of empty file-list ports in TrialCase
questions: Must an empty input file-list port still be named by a StoredValuesRef, or is that port intentionally absent from TrialCase.inputs?
Must every expected-output port be named in TrialCase.expected_outputs, or does an unnamed output port represent an expected empty file list?

quotes: A trial case therefore names exactly the contract's input ports, and expected_outputs is either absent or names exactly every output port: a partial expected_outputs, and an empty object, is given and fails presence at its first missing port; only absence means no expected outputs.

MUST call read_records only with at least one identity, made only when there is a value_id to name, since read_records refuses an empty identity list as malformed: an input or an expected output of a file list with no files names no StoredValuesRef, so it is read with no call — the input's payload is a FileListPayload with no contents and the expected output's digests are the empty list —, and an expected file list with no files matches an output file list with no files.

When the case has expected outputs, they MUST be compared per output port of the contract version, never per port the refs happen to name: an output port that no expected StoredValuesRef names is an expected file list with no files.
judgement.why: One passage requires every input and expected-output port to be named, while the changed passage requires empty file-list ports to have no StoredValuesRef and treats an unnamed expected-output port as an empty file list.

topics.topic: Whether an empty SpooledFilesRef reads records or skips the read
questions: Must an empty SpooledFilesRef call read_records as the unconditional field-projection rule says, or make no read as the new behavior rule says?
Must an empty SpooledFilesRef read its SpooledFile records as the field-projection passage requires, or make no read as the behavior passage requires?

Must an empty SpooledFilesRef call read_records as the unqualified FIELD_PROJECTION rule requires, or make no read as the new BEHAVIOR rule requires; should the former be qualified to apply only when files is non-empty?

quotes: a SpooledFilesRef reads its SpooledFile records with SpooledFilesByKey with when_missing internal_error and each becomes ShownFile carrying its full SpooledFileKey and no value_id

MUST call read_records only when a PortRef names at least one item, since read_records refuses an empty identity list as malformed: a SpooledFilesRef whose files are empty, a file list with no files, becomes a ShownPort with the same port name and no ShownItem, and makes no read.
judgement.why: The unqualified field-projection requirement says a SpooledFilesRef reads its records, while the new behavior requirement says an empty one makes no read.
